scientific_integrity: The statement is a self-reviewed proof with independently replayable finite tests; tests are not a general proof and no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Odd-characteristic finite fields only, m>=3, algebra associated to adjacency matrix of star K_(1,m); no classification of conjugacy classes, random-walk evolution algebras or characteristic two. Priority not independently established.
title: Automorphism groups of star-graph evolution algebras over odd finite fields
